```{r}
## Setup

### Packages
install.packages('tidyverse')

library(tidyverse)

tidyverse_packages()

read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")

penguins <- read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")

penguins |> head()
penguins |> tail()
penguins |> View()
penguins |> summary()
penguins |> colnames()
penguins |> dim()

penguins |>
    na.omit() |> #remove the NAs and THEN
    view()

```
